caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional rectangular object, possibly a chest or box, decorated on its visible sides and top with painted scenes. The main visible side shows a landscape with a blue sky and dark green ground, dotted with medium green trees with brown trunks. There is a brown and beige windmill labeled "WIND MILL," and a log-style house in beige with a black roof in the background. The foreground has three brown and beige covered wagons with blue wheels, each pulled by a brown horse, and each carrying different contents such as logs or goods. The top of the box has a blue background with two reclining beige figures, dogs, or possibly stylized animals, and additional trees and foliage. The overall color scheme is dominated by blues, greens, and browns, with black and beige accents outlining key elements and figures. The composition is arranged with objects and landscape wrapping seamlessly around the visible surfaces of the box.
title: Bandbox or Hat Box
